title: Interactive amendment
description: A recorded divergence between what a logical change contained before an interactive `edit` and what it contains after, under the same identity (shared-portable note record; src/rebase-operations.js completeInteractiveStep). It exists because `edit` is the one operation that changes content while keeping identity: without it, a peer holding a receipt for that identity would go on reporting it covered for content that no longer exists (ADR-0035). A reader that has this record downgrades a bare Change-Id match for the identity from `covered` to `candidate-equivalent`; a receipt naming the specific commit still proves that commit, and ancestry still proves what ancestry proves.

changeId.description: The identity whose content diverged. It is retained, not replaced: an edit is not a fork.

commit.description: The rewritten commit carrying the edited content. The record is attached to it.

originCommit.description: The commit the edit was replayed from.

treeBefore.description: The tree as replayed, before the caller changed anything.

treeAfter.description: The tree the caller committed. It is never equal to treeBefore: an edit that changed nothing publishes no amendment, because nothing diverged.
